blocks.text: I’m Maksim, and I made this translation!

This site hosts a fan-made Russian translation of the **Draw Steel** tabletop roleplaying game for reference.

The translation is a noncommercial project.

All rights to the original work, including its rules, setting, illustrations and trademarks, belong to **MCDM Productions LLC**.

When a retainer gains a new ability, choose either their own retainer ability or the ability for their role at that level. The signature damage increases apply only to their signature ability.

For example, a goblin guide who starts at level 1 and reaches level 4 gains 27 Stamina, 2 free strike damage, and 2 damage on tier 1 and 3 damage on tiers 2 and 3 of their signature ability.

The translation team compiled this table from the rules and example in [Retainers](#/codex/monsters.chapter.retainers). The English source export refers to the table but omits its contents.

#### Purchased Traits

You have 3 ancestry points to spend on the following traits. *Quick Build:* Piercing Horns and Beast Regeneration.

#### Purchased Traits

You have 3 ancestry points to spend on the following traits. *Quick Build:* Wings and Hit the Liver.

ancestry.tauros.name: Tauros
ancestry.tauros.text:
Created for the Last Myth campaign, tauros, also called minotaurs, descend from demons who emerged during the Infernal Breach. Their ancestors retained their minds despite the rage and thirst for destruction that consumed the others.

Their humanoid shape does little to disguise their heritage. They stand taller than most other ancestries and have a bull’s features. Some are born with cloven hooves and tails. Each bears a pair of weathered horns, a source of pride for every minotaur.

As the Twilight War waned, the tauros scattered across the Expanse, drawn to the hunt and to the distant horizon. Their communities are mostly tribal, and they rarely settle in one place for long.

## Tauros Traits

Minotaur heroes have access to the following physiological benefits.

ancestry.tauros.signature.call-of-the-ho.name: Call of the Horizon
ancestry.tauros.signature.call-of-the-ho.text: **Signature trait.** You are a gifted navigator. You have one additional skill from the exploration skill group (see [Skills](#/codex/1208)).

ancestry.tauros.signature.beast-still-wi.name: Beast Still Within
ancestry.tauros.signature.beast-still-wi.text: **Signature trait.** The beast still stirs within you, and its anger makes you stronger. When you force move a creature or object, the distance of that forced movement gains a +1 bonus.

ancestry.tauros.piercing-horns.name: Piercing Horns
ancestry.tauros.piercing-horns.text: **1 point.** Your horns are sharp as well as imposing. Once per round when you make a melee strike, you can deal extra damage with the strike equal to your highest characteristic score.

ancestry.tauros.beast-legs.name: Beast Legs
ancestry.tauros.beast-legs.text: **1 point.** Your powerful legs make you noticeably faster. Your speed is 6.

ancestry.tauros.grounded.name: Grounded
ancestry.tauros.grounded.text: **1 point.** You move when you choose to. You gain a +1 bonus to stability.

ancestry.tauros.undeterred.name: Undeterred
ancestry.tauros.undeterred.text: **1 point.** You shrug off feeble attacks. Your Might score is considered 1 higher for resisting potencies. You gain an edge on Might tests to resist environmental effects or a creature’s features or abilities.

ancestry.tauros.let-loose.name: Let Loose
ancestry.tauros.let-loose.text:
**2 points.** You gain the following signature ability.

*With a furious roar, you let the beast loose.*

**Area, Melee · Main action**

**Distance:** 1 burst · **Target:** Each enemy in the area

**Power Roll + Might or Presence:**
- **≤11:** 2 damage
- **12–16:** 5 damage; push 1
- **17+:** 7 damage; push 2

ancestry.tauros.beast-regeneration.name: Beast Regeneration
ancestry.tauros.beast-regeneration.text: **2 points.** Your wounds close with unnatural speed. If you are winded at the start of your turn, you regain Stamina equal to your echelon.

ancestry.lizardfolk.name: Lizardfolk
ancestry.lizardfolk.text:
Created for the Last Myth campaign, lizardfolk are small, dragonlike creatures. They descend from the great true dragons the gods wiped out in an ancient war.

Few see those mythical creatures in a lizardfolk’s slight frame. Yet they share their ancestors’ scales, long snouts and heavy tails, and some are born with wings. Even so, few people take them seriously.

Over generations, lizardfolk have learned to turn this to their advantage. They are known for cunning and agility, though those traits hardly define them. Lizardfolk know their worth and always find a way to survive in a world that mocks them.

## Lizardfolk Traits

Lizardfolk heroes have access to the following physiological benefits.

ancestry.lizardfolk.signature.instinctiv.name: Instinctive Agility
ancestry.lizardfolk.signature.instinctiv.text: **Signature trait.** You have learned to survive in a world that sees you as prey. When a creature is about to make a strike against you, you can use a triggered action to shift up to 2 squares. You also have one additional skill from the intrigue skill group (see [Skills](#/codex/1208)).

ancestry.lizardfolk.reactive-movement.name: Reactive Movement
ancestry.lizardfolk.reactive-movement.text: **1 point.** Your light step lets you change position quickly. When you are force moved, you can use a free triggered action to shift 1 square after the forced movement ends.

ancestry.lizardfolk.wings.name: Wings
ancestry.lizardfolk.wings.text: **2 points.** You have wings strong enough to lift you into the air. When you fly using your wings, you can stay aloft for a number of rounds equal to your Might score (minimum 1 round) before you fall. While flying this way at level 3 or lower, you have damage weakness 5.

ancestry.lizardfolk.dragon-heritage.name: Dragon Heritage
ancestry.lizardfolk.dragon-heritage.text:
**2 points.** You gain the following signature ability.

*A furious breath of energy washes over your foes.*

**Area, Magic · Main action**

**Distance:** 3 cube within 1 · **Target:** Each enemy in the area

**Power Roll + Might or Presence:**
- **≤11:** 2 damage
- **12–16:** 4 damage
- **17+:** 6 damage

**Effect:** Choose the ability’s damage type from acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning or poison.

ancestry.lizardfolk.barbed-tail.name: Barbed Tail
ancestry.lizardfolk.barbed-tail.text: **1 point.** Your barbed tail lets you punctuate your actions. Once per round when you make a melee strike, you can deal extra damage with the strike equal to your highest characteristic score.

ancestry.lizardfolk.slippery-scales.name: Slippery Scales
ancestry.lizardfolk.slippery-scales.text: **1 point.** Your scales make you hard to hold. You have the Escape Artist skill from the intrigue skill group, and enemies take a bane on attempts to grab you.

ancestry.lizardfolk.hit-the-liver.name: Hit the Liver
ancestry.lizardfolk.hit-the-liver.text: **1 point.** Your ability rolls gain an edge against a creature adjacent to at least one of your allies who is not a minion. You do not gain another edge for flanking that creature with the same ally.
